title: Home Office rejects Palestinian Jerusalemite woman’s UK visa but approves husband’s
summary_full: Officials not satisfied Therese Abdallah is a ‘genuine visitor’ and believe she would not leave after visit to son in LondonA Palestinian Jerusalemite who lives in London has been left devastated after a planned trip by his parents had to be cancelled when the Home Office ruled his mother was not a “genuine visitor” but granted his father a visa.Karim Abdallah, who has lived in the UK since 2019, was looking forward to hosting his parents, Therese Abdallah, 69, a retired English teacher, and his father, Ghassan Abdallah, a psychologist, for a few weeks.
